Payments infrastructure, dual-headquartered in South San Francisco and Dublin (Wikipedia). The pre-filled 'acquired' is a wrong join: Stripe is private, valued at $159B in its February 2026 tender offer (Wikipedia). Ribbit's first dated Stripe vehicle is ST-IC Ribbit Opportunity V (Form D, 2021 Q2, $15.1M sold); the ADV adds ST-H (the Series H of March 2021, $600M at $95B) and ST-TO (a tender). Stripe was past its Series G by then, so the entry is Growth whichever 2021 round it was; the firm lists Stripe only from 2025.

'Previously raised $6 million from Ribbit Capital, Felicis Ventures, and Vy Capital Management' across its seed and Series A, so Ribbit's round cannot be told apart; $20M Series B led by Valor Equity Partners (2022-05-31). Payments blockchain incubated by Stripe and Paradigm (CEO Matt Huang). City aligned with the Thrive row.

The Open Platform (TOP), the Dubai-based builder of Telegram's crypto wallet, founded by Andrew Rogozov. 'The equity round was led by Ribbit Capital ... with Pantera Capital also participating': a $28.5M Series A extension at a $1B valuation, the first unicorn in the TON ecosystem (the company's release, 2025-07-03). The mark sits exactly on the $1B band edge. Earlier seed money came in before, with no Ribbit role named, so the entry is read at the round Ribbit led (medium).

Bengaluru-based buy-now-pay-later lender. Ribbit is named an existing backer in the $20M Series B led by Quona Capital (Entrackr, April 2019) and held 16.6% by 2021; the firm listed ZestMoney by January 2017 (archived Our Bets page), before the $6.5M Series A PayU led (announced February 2017), so Ribbit's round is not named.
